_comment: Story 036 §16 — per-binary-version fixture index. Maps each claude binary version label to its corpus path + HONEST provenance. See CORPUS.md. Drift between the two sets is exercised by the regression harness (regression-harness.test.ts) and logged non-fatally (R3.2).

versions.basis: Synthesized from the documented 2.1.121->2.1.159 format/taxonomy differences (IMPLEMENTACAO-FORK-ACP.md §16/§10). No real 2.1.121 capture exists in this repo; this set is DERIVED, not a real binary capture.
driftNotes: entrypoint-taxonomy drift: billable events carry the older 'claude-cli' label, which is NOT in the §10 SUBSCRIPTION_ENTRYPOINTS set (frozen for 2.1.159); the modern set uses 'cli'.
JSONL-format drift: a simple text turn carries message.content as a bare STRING (string-vs-array ambiguity), where the 2.1.159 set carries an ARRAY of blocks for the equivalent turn.

versions.basis: Synthesized to be FAITHFUL to the documented 2.1.159 format + §10 entrypoint taxonomy — the binary the fork (src/billing/) was reverse-engineered against. Real transcripts are non-committable user projects (cf. the story-017 reference fixture header).
driftNotes: entrypoint='cli' is in the §10 SUBSCRIPTION_ENTRYPOINTS set (subscription billing).
message.content for a text turn is an ARRAY of content blocks (the modern shape).

versions.basis: Synthesized to be FAITHFUL to the documented 2.1.159->2.1.176 changelog deltas (story 050 REBASE-AND-DRIFT.md, binary axis 2.1.159->2.1.186). No real 2.1.176 capture exists in this repo; this set is DERIVED, carrying the modern 'cli' subscription taxonomy and the array content shape unchanged from 2.1.159.
driftNotes: entrypoint='cli' remains in the §10 SUBSCRIPTION_ENTRYPOINTS set — no billing-taxonomy drift vs 2.1.159.

behavioural: subagent-of-subagent nesting context was introduced around 2.1.172 (sub-sidechains can themselves spawn) — the JSONL parentUuid/parentToolUseId shape is unchanged; only the depth the linearizer may see grows.
permission-rule syntax churn lands just after (approx 2.1.178) — not reflected in this synthetic transcript (out of scope: this story detects, it does not act).

versions.basis: Synthesized to be FAITHFUL to the documented 2.1.176->2.1.185 changelog deltas (story 050 REBASE-AND-DRIFT.md). No real 2.1.185 capture exists; this set is DERIVED. 2.1.185 is the version the live machine ran when story 049 was authored (it has since drifted to 2.1.186 — the thesis in action).
driftNotes: entrypoint='cli' remains subscription — no billing-taxonomy drift vs 2.1.159.

behavioural: stall-hint timing was tuned around this range (the watchdog/idle-hint cadence) — a timing concern, not a JSONL-shape or stop_reason change; the reduced-shape keys and stop_reason taxonomy are unchanged.
the live binary kept moving (2.1.185 -> 2.1.186 within days), which is exactly the undetected drift this story makes observable.
